scope: future Gate4 replacement design constraints after 001E baseline-equivalence negative evidence

forbidden_fix_patterns.reason: Encryption blocks inspection rather than proving a mechanism. It can convert auditability failure into apparent non-recoverability.
Obfuscation hides target leakage instead of removing it and weakens trace/replay evidence.
Changing language/runtime does not change the evidence problem and can create unreviewed second logic paths.
Renaming target-bearing fields is cosmetic if faithful baselines can still recover the target.
Baselines must receive fair information access. Candidate-only equivalent access invalidates baseline comparison.
Baselines must match candidate query and feedback affordances. Weakening them manufactures candidate advantage.
Candidate-specific construction risks fitting the benchmark to the candidate instead of testing mechanism non-equivalence.
Post-hoc tuning patches outcomes rather than fixing the collapsed problem definition.
A trace-only lookup with renamed keys remains a non-mechanism explanation unless the future task precludes it under fair access.

allowed_only_if_separately_authorized.condition: Must be a bounded task card under the reset requirements and must not implement or run a new experiment.
